TZA.note: Sectors named only as areas of AI adoption in Africa generally.
Lab provides a workspace and capacity building; no model, dataset or computing stated.

facts.fact: IDRC reports an active grant from 2024-09-01 to the University of Dodoma to scale up the African AI Lab (AfriAI Lab) in Tanzania, which will conduct exploratory research and contribute evidence for AI policymaking in Tanzania.
